prompt: Write acceptance criteria for this user story: As a registered user, I want to reset my password by email so that I can get back into my account. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. The new password must have at least 12 characters. If the email is not registered, the page shows "If this email is registered, we sent a link." Single sign-on accounts are out of scope.
output:
## Acceptance criteria: password reset by email

Requirement: A registered user resets their password by email to get back into their account. The reset link expires after 30 minutes, the new password needs at least 12 characters, and an unregistered email gets a fixed message.

### Main path
AC-1. Given a registered user, when the user resets their password by email, then the user can get back into their account. _I want to reset my password by email so that I can get back into my account_

### Validation and errors
AC-2. Given a user setting a new password, when the user enters a new password with fewer than 12 characters, then the new password is not accepted. _The new password must have at least 12 characters._
AC-3. Given an email that is not registered, when the user submits it for a password reset, then the page shows "If this email is registered, we sent a link." _If the email is not registered, the page shows "If this email is registered, we sent a link."_

### Limits
AC-4. Given a reset link whose 30 minutes have passed, when the user opens it, then the link no longer resets the password. _The reset link expires after 30 minutes._

### Open questions
- [blocking] Limits: From which moment do the 30 minutes of the reset link start? Blocks: AC-4
- [minor] Main path: What does the page show when the submitted email is registered? Limits: How many times can one reset link be used?

### Out of scope
- Single sign-on accounts. _Single sign-on accounts are out of scope._
